rule: Two adjacent grid borders carry full edge lines in two colours, each with a ragged same-colour fringe. The other two borders carry dotted grey (5) lines. One rectangle has a full-length marker line of each edge colour on two adjacent sides. The output is the rectangle without the markers, with 0 bites kept. It is re-oriented by the unique one of the 8 dihedral transforms that sends both marker sides to the border sides of the same colours. For train pair 1 that transform is the anti-transpose, which a single-marker rotation rule would get wrong.
scope: Random scenes sample both edge-corner placements (4 combinations) and all 8 marker-side/orientation combinations. Also sampled: grid sizes 14..30 per side, independent or square (12..30 explicitly; non-22/29 sizes are synthetic extensions), edge and fill colours, 1..4 glyph colours, glyph layouts (segments, dashes, blobs, hollow boxes, period-2 bar bands, L-lines), bites 1..2 deep on the non-marker sides, fringe depth 0..2, and grey dot depth 1..2. Explicit latent arguments reconstruct all four canonical fixtures. Deliberately unsupported: multiple rectangles, open-field distractors, markers on opposite sides, grey as an edge colour, and symmetric rectangles.

authored_constraints: 0 is the strict global majority colour.
Each border line's strict majority non-zero colour is its edge colour or grey 5, with no ties.
Edge colours differ from each other, from 0 and from 5; the rectangle uses neither edge colour nor 5.
The rectangle plus its markers is 4-connected and keeps a one-cell 8-neighbour gap from every border-connected cell.
Every border row and column of the rectangle has a non-zero cell, so its bounding box equals the rectangle.
The two markers are full-length lines on adjacent rectangle sides.
The cropped rectangle has no nontrivial dihedral symmetry (random and explicit modes).
In random scenes, bites lie on non-marker sides only and never cover a corner shared with a marker side.
Explicit mode rejects partial or inconsistent latent arguments; random mode rejects layout arguments given without a rect.
